title: Angelica archangelica tea for medicinal use
intro: Angelica archangelica tea is a herbal preparation made from the dried roots and leaves of the Angelica archangelica plant, commonly known as garden angelica. This tea is traditionally used in herbalism to support digestive health, alleviate menstrual discomfort, and promote respiratory wellness. It is often consumed as a warming tonic to help with nausea, bloating, and cold symptoms. The plant is also valued for its potential to boost energy and support the immune system. Due to its strong potency, it is typically used in small doses and under the guidance of a qualified herbalist.
